about: One SQL reading contract: map-viewer/test/query.js and scripts/test_query.py hold the viewer and the checker to these same results. expect: ok (with its top-level outputs), syntax (a mistake) or unsupported (valid SQL the reader does not explain yet).

cases.name: plain
cases.sql: SELECT o.id FROM orders o

cases.name: MINUS oracle
cases.sql: SELECT o.id FROM orders o MINUS SELECT c.id FROM customers c

cases.name: UNION in FROM subquery
cases.sql: SELECT s.id FROM (SELECT o.id FROM orders o UNION ALL SELECT c.id FROM customers c) s

cases.name: UNION in parens
cases.sql: (SELECT o.id FROM orders o) UNION ALL (SELECT c.id FROM customers c)

cases.name: UNION then ORDER
cases.sql: SELECT o.id FROM orders o UNION SELECT c.id FROM customers c ORDER BY id

cases.name: FETCH FIRST
cases.sql: SELECT o.id FROM orders o ORDER BY o.id FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

cases.name: OFFSET FETCH
cases.sql: SELECT o.id FROM orders o ORDER BY o.id OFFSET 5 ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY

cases.name: TOP
cases.sql: SELECT TOP 10 o.id FROM orders o

cases.name: TOP PERCENT alias
cases.sql: SELECT TOP 10 PERCENT o.id AS x FROM orders o

cases.name: DISTINCT ON
cases.sql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (o.id) o.id FROM orders o

cases.name: QUALIFY
cases.sql: SELECT o.id FROM orders o QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY o.id)=1

cases.name: WINDOW clause
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(o.id) OVER w AS s FROM orders o WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY o.status)

cases.name: FOR UPDATE after WHERE
cases.sql: SELECT o.id FROM orders o WHERE o.id>0 FOR UPDATE

cases.name: FOR UPDATE no WHERE
cases.sql: SELECT o.id FROM orders o FOR UPDATE

cases.name: FOR JSON

cases.name: CONNECT BY no WHERE
cases.sql: SELECT o.id FROM orders o START WITH o.id=1 CONNECT BY PRIOR o.id=o.customer_id

cases.sql: WITH RECURSIVE x AS (SELECT o.id FROM orders o) SELECT x.id FROM x
